meta.exhibitDescription: A citable imprint of a control-room slice: content addressed by a content hash, with sources, the imprint and the data-retrieval date in the citation footer.
meta.graphCitationDescription: A permanent citation of one view of the Czech-politics knowledge graph: the claims, the human-review state of every edge, the sources and the content fingerprint at the moment of issue.
meta.krajDescription: Pick a region and get its MPs' slate: contribution index, components, badges — with source and date, ready to print.
meta.krajCardDescription: The MP slate ({count}): {kraj}. Contribution index from open psp.cz data, with source and date, ready to print.
meta.plakatDescription: The print form of the contribution-index leaderboard: an A4/A3 sheet with an archival citation footer (source, data state, methodology).

graph.exhibitLink: Exhibit — a citable imprint of this slice
graph.exhibitNote: an exhibit = a permanent citable imprint of this slice — the address carries a content hash, the content is re-derived from the registries anew; every traffic row has an imprint too (the stamp by the row)

feed.exhibitLink: Exhibit — a citable imprint of this fact

exhibit.lead: A self-contained, citable imprint from the control room: the content is addressed by the imprint in the URL, not by a database row — on every view the page deterministically re-derives it from the same registries and admits any difference against the published version.
exhibit.staleNotice: the content has changed since this link was issued — the imprint in the address {urlHash} ≠ today's imprint {currentHash}; shown is today's build, not the cited one
exhibit.goneTitle: Today's build of the ledger no longer derives this fact
exhibit.goneBody: The ledger of dated facts is a window over a living graph — newer facts may have pushed this row out, or the underlying data changed. Nothing gets substituted: an exhibit either matches the published imprint, or says so.
exhibit.noPublicLink: registry without a public link — the exhibit label carries the source's literal name

finder.title: Connect two dots
finder.intro: Pick two nodes — the canvas lights up the shortest documented path between them, step by step.
finder.unavailable: path finding isn't available in this run — it's waiting on a connected data warehouse
finder.empty: No path of documented graph edges connects the selected nodes within {steps}. That is a finding too: the connection is not documented in our data.
finder.rule: Ordering rule: the shortest path over evidence edges (co-voting is not used), at most {steps}; a node with {hub} or more edges counts as two steps, so the path doesn't run through the biggest hubs. Ties go to fewer unverified edges, then a higher contract amount, then alphabetical order. {found}

cite.copyFailed: copying failed — select the address below manually
cite.issueFailed: the citation can't be issued right now — the view couldn't be documented from the data
cite.hint: the permanent link carries the whole view and the evidence fingerprint — for citing in an article

permalink.lead: A citable view of the knowledge graph: the address carries the full view state and the evidence fingerprint at the moment of issue — on every visit the page deterministically re-derives the content from the registers and admits any difference against the cited version.
permalink.staleNotice: the content has changed since this link was issued — the fingerprint in the address {urlHash} ≠ today's fingerprint {currentHash}; shown is today's re-derivation, not the cited one
permalink.pathGoneTitle: Today's graph no longer documents this path
permalink.pathGoneBody: The citation pointed to a computed evidence path; the underlying data has changed since it was issued, and no equally short path exists under this ordering today. Nothing similar is substituted — a citation either matches the issued fingerprint, or says so.
permalink.rule: Ordering rule: the shortest path over evidence edges (co-voting is not used), at most {steps}; a node with {hub} or more edges counts as two steps. Ties go to fewer unverified edges, then a higher contract amount, then alphabetical order. {found}
permalink.quoteLine: “{title}” — politicas, a knowledge graph of Czech politics. Retrieved {date}.
permalink.citationLine: “{title}” — politicas, a knowledge graph of Czech politics. Retrieved {date}. {url} · fingerprint {algo} {hash}.
permalink.bundleNote: a machine-readable list of claims with the human-review state of every edge
permalink.goneTitle: Today's graph no longer documents this view
permalink.goneBody: The address is readable and once carried a documented view, but the knowledge graph is recomputed in batches and the cited node, trail or path is not in today's build. Nothing similar is substituted: a citation either matches the issued fingerprint, or says so.

og.pathGone: the path is no longer documented in today's graph

civicscore.lensStickyLine: your index — weights {weights} · not the published methodology
civicscore.lensTableNote: ordered by your weights (open index, /01) — not the published index; the button in the top strip restores the default methodology
civicscore.lensHistogramNote: the distribution under your index — recomputed from the published components by your weights (lens rule, see /01); not the published methodology
civicscore.lensDuelNote: the head-to-head under your index — score and components recomputed by your weights (lens rule, see /01); not the published methodology
civicscore.dossierFilterTitle: MPs with a work profile (effort-loop enrichment)
civicscore.weightPanelLead: Every ranking rests on weights. Here the weights are sliders: set your own priorities and the whole page — the distribution, the head-to-head and all {count} rows — recomputes under your lens. The link carries it with you.
civicscore.lensStatusDefault: showing the published methodology (the official index)
civicscore.lensPresetsNote: editorial example lenses — they are no organization's methodology
civicscore.weightTotalZero: — all weights are zero, the index comes out 0.0 for everyone
civicscore.lensRule: lens rule: each component contributes its published fill rate (points ÷ published weight), your weights are rescaled to sum to 100, and the index is their weighted sum, rounded to tenths. It is computed from points published to tenths, so it can differ from the authoritative graph score by up to 0.1 pt. Default methodology {weights} (psp.cz, deterministic computation).
civicscore.krajEmpty: A region with no MPs on record.
civicscore.krajSourceNote: regional election card — a cut of the contribution-index leaderboard, psp.cz · PSP10
civicscore.krajLead: Your region's slate: the MPs elected for {subject}, ordered by the contribution index. The card prints as an A4/A3 sheet — on paper only the slate remains, with a source citation and a date.
civicscore.krajPosterLeadUnassigned: Mandates for which the psp.cz register states no region — an acknowledged gap in the record, not a fourteenth region. Ordering and scores follow the same methodology as the national leaderboard.
civicscore.krajPosterLead: All MPs elected for this region, ordered by the contribution index — a composite 0–100 score from the Chamber of Deputies' open data. Regional rung on the left, national rung by the score; no number was made anywhere but in {origin}.
civicscore.krajLensStrip: your index — weights {weights} · the reader's own lens, not the published methodology
civicscore.krajFootnote: order: competition ranking (1, 2, 2, 4) in the region and nationally — identical scores share a rung, “=” marks a shared one; within a tie only the alphabet decides and it carries no meaning · component bars: fill rate of the six index components (úč = participation, výb = committees, leg = legislation, sál = floor speeches, doch = attendance, ved = leadership)
civicscore.krajUnassignedNote: {count} mandates carry no region in the register
civicscore.krajLensHint: You can re-set the index weights on the leaderboard (Open index section) — a link with ?vahy=… then carries your lens here onto the card too.
civicscore.krajPickerSource: regions from PSP10 mandates — psp.cz register, electoral-region organ
civicscore.krajPickerLead: Who is actually in my region, and what have they done? Pick a region and you get its MPs' slate — ordered by the contribution index, with source and date, ready to print for the fridge.
civicscore.krajPickerNoData: The knowledge graph is unavailable — the region picker does not render without data.
civicscore.krajNoMatch: No region by that name — the full list of {count} entries is below.
civicscore.krajPickerFootnote: an MP's region comes from the PSP10 mandate; mandates with no region in the register go to an honest “region not stated” bucket — nothing is imputed
civicscore.trendSource: Source: psp.cz · committee memberships + bills/interpellations/stenographic records {term}
civicscore.trendSourcePass: Source: psp.cz · committee memberships + bills/interpellations/stenographic records {term} · graph pass {pass}
civicscore.trendPendingHead: {missing} for term {term} will appear once the {term} roll-call votes are ingested
civicscore.trendPendingComparable: — comparable right now is only this: {list}.
